items.title: John "Knocky" Parker Interview, 1963-08-28
items.q: the violinist, Kenneth Fitz simply copied them all from the records and we had everything.

ctx.x: How were these old fiddle breakdowns in the repertoire of the band?

They'd always been there. This Cecil, the first of Brower, no, Cliff Gross. Cliff Gross from Bowling Green, Kentucky had been the first one who played them. And whenever he left the band, we had to get ASCAP came in later on and we had to clear everything and clear all the breakdowns too. And we didn't know. He was the one who played all of them and we didn't know those. And when he left the band, he took with him his whole catalog and itinerary. But he had left, we used to make record every day. Every day we…
Well, how did you regard yourself via people like Roy Acuff and the Grand Ole Opry crew?
